title: Hedgehog dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- Hedgehog dancing: spiky back, face, arms and legs in motion -->
    <!-- body/spines -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="26" ry="22" fill="#8b5e3c"/>
    <!-- spikes -->
    <g fill="#a97a4f">
      <polygon points="30,48 27,38 36,44"/>
      <polygon points="40,42 39,31 47,40"/>
      <polygon points="50,40 51,29 57,39"/>
      <polygon points="60,42 63,32 66,42"/>
      <polygon points="68,48 73,40 73,50"/>
    </g>
    <!-- lighter belly/face area -->
    <ellipse cx="58" cy="66" rx="16" ry="15" fill="#f2c48d"/>
    <!-- snout -->
    <ellipse cx="70" cy="66" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#ffe0b0"/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <circle cx="77" cy="64" r="2.6" fill="#a86b2e"/>
    <!-- eye -->
    <circle cx="65" cy="61" r="2.6" fill="#3b2a1a"/>
    <circle cx="65.8" cy="60.2" r="0.9" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d="M71,70 Q74,73 78,70" fill="none" stroke="#a86b2e" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- ear -->
    <ellipse cx="60" cy="54" rx="4" ry="4" fill="#e0a566"/>
    <!-- arms waving -->
    <path d="M44,62 Q34,52 30,44" fill="none" stroke="#8b5e3c" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M58,72 Q66,80 74,84" fill="none" stroke="#8b5e3c" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- hands -->
    <circle cx="30" cy="44" r="3.4" fill="#e0a566"/>
    <circle cx="74" cy="84" r="3.4" fill="#e0a566"/>
    <!-- legs -->
    <path d="M42,82 Q40,90 34,92" fill="none" stroke="#8b5e3c" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M56,84 Q58,92 62,94" fill="none" stroke="#8b5e3c" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- feet -->
    <ellipse cx="33" cy="93" rx="5" ry="3.2" fill="#e0a566"/>
    <ellipse cx="63" cy="94" rx="5" ry="3.2" fill="#e0a566"/>
    <!-- motion marks -->
    <g stroke="#f6d38a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
      <path d="M20,60 Q16,66 20,72"/>
      <path d="M82,52 Q86,58 82,64"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
